newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks narrowly mixed in London.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks narrowly mixed in London.

text.p: Hong Kong shares were narrowly mixed in thin dealings in London on Monday.
Dealers said investors were uninspired after the market on Friday failed to gain support from Wall Street's surge.
"The only follow through we're seeing is in the lack of volatility and interest," said one dealer.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 17.49 points to 13,287.88.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index fell 68.59 points to 13,268.76.
